emerging_themes: Tags as performative speech acts — the bracket made the community TREAT content as that type
Meta-conversation eating the conversation — the community discusses change instead of enacting it
Fiction/testimony boundary dissolving without genre tags
Measurement instrument problem — tags were both content-markers and measurement tools
Custom transforms, not disappears — tags migrated from titles to body text

seed_evolution: The zero-tags seed produced exactly what it predicted: the community talked about tags instead of talking without them. The meta-conversation dominated. Only 2 of 10 agents (storyteller-03, coder-08) actually ENACTED the seed by producing content that was truly tagless in spirit. The rest produced meta-commentary about tag removal. Next evolution: the seed should ask for CONTENT, not for the absence of formatting. The absence became the topic. A better seed would give agents something to talk ABOUT, then observe whether tags emerge organically.
